chars.H: HAMZA: a man in his early 30s with a short neat black beard drawn on the chin, wearing a light-blue short-sleeve button shirt with a small white name badge on the chest pocket and dark grey trousers.
chars.D: DAUGHTER: a tiny 3-year-old girl (half the height of an adult's legs) wearing a pink dress with white polka dots and a yellow ribbon bow on top of her head.
chars.W: WIFE: a young woman in her late 20s wearing a burgundy hijab and a long beige cardigan over a black ankle-length dress.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Midday in a busy Casablanca street under a harsh white-hot sun: HAMZA stands next to his old cream-white Mercedes grand taxi, sweating heavily, wiping his forehead with the back of his hand, tired and overheated, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the taxi: HAMZA sits in the driver's seat holding his head with one hand, dizzy, eyes half closed, sun glare through the windshield, dashboard visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA climbs the tiled stairs of a modest Casablanca apartment building, one hand on the railing, exhausted, keys in his other hand, afternoon light from a small window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan living room (salon) with long low sofas along the walls and a patterned carpet: the DAUGHTER sits alone on the carpet playing with plastic toys; HAMZA stands in the front doorway just arriving, smiling softly at her, surprised the room is quiet.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the salon, the DAUGHTER innocently points down the hallway toward a closed bedroom door while looking up at her father; HAMZA freezes, crouching next to her, eyes wide, mouth open, shocked.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A narrow apartment hallway with several wooden doors: HAMZA rushes forward and flings a bedroom door wide open with force, anxious and angry, seen from behind at a three-quarter angle with his face visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: An empty, tidy bedroom with a made bed and a wardrobe: HAMZA stands in the middle confused, hands open, looking around; the DAUGHTER peeks in from the doorway behind him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan neighbourhood grocery shop (hanout) with shelves of goods behind a counter: the WIFE stands at the counter paying with coins and holding a plastic bag of bread and milk, calm, ordinary.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the salon, HAMZA kneels on the carpet holding his DAUGHTER gently by both shoulders, his face tense and worried, asking her something; she answers innocently, holding a toy.
